$description: Semantic type families + the figures rule (BRAND-RECONCILIATION.md §5-B). Figures (prices/profit/%) use Plus Jakarta Sans TABULAR by default; IBM Plex Mono is RESERVED for evidence/identifiers (card no., cert, SKU, indexing) — it is NOT the default numeric face.

display.$description: Headings / brand display (Plus Jakarta, weight+scale+tracking express).

product.$description: UI + body + figures (Plus Jakarta; figures use tabular-nums).

evidence.$description: Evidence/identifiers ONLY — card no., cert, SKU, indexing (IBM Plex Mono).

figures.$description: Apply to prices/profit/% for aligned tabular lining figures.
